mapper.select: select * from d_order where order_status = #{orderStatus,jdbcType=INTEGER} and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and (expiry_next_retry_time is null or expiry_next_retry_time <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) and status = 1 and (#{partitionCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} = 1 or MOD(id, #{partitionCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}) = #{partitionIndex,jdbcType=INTEGER}) order by expire_time, id limit #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.delete: delete from d_order where order_status in (1,2,3,4)
